profile_hook.coverage_limit: Patches workflow.reconstruct imported name only; not independently imported transfer/other contexts. Native fixture has no layout; transfer resolution and other code outside these contexts remains in whole call but has no separate hook event.
profile_hook.event_retention: events list retains scalar dictionaries until child JSON/teardown; kwargs actual source carries only time_index scalar and stage string. Hook does not inspect caller frames or store ndarrays.
profile_hook.frame_limits: Extra active contextmanager/generator frames, closure cells, kwargs and record temporaries exist. Original workflow_stage failure translation (both modes) explicitly reads traceback frames/f_locals t/d and cause; exceptions/tracebacks can retain numerical locals during unwinding. Therefore not frame-free or allocation-free; no measured overhead claim.
profile_hook.failure_export: Exit finally runs during ordinary unwinding, but workload_child assigns stages=events only after successful call. A raised workflow call bypasses that assignment; main emits workflow_exception and exit1, not a fabricated complete event stream. Abrupt termination gives no completion promise.
profile_hook.log_io: No stage file or per-event flush: list is serialized once in final child stdout JSON. Parent samples.jsonl write+flush at declared sample interval occurs for both profiles/unprofiled; profile JSON can add serialization/pipe/disk/collection costs and OS-cache effects.

Full result retains bands/overlaps/known filtered q/stage image plus separate final image/coordinate copies. Hook does not deliberately capture those arrays but cannot isolate their costs.
